new_packages.label: אַבְרָהָם, יָמִין, חָכְמָה וָחֶסֶד
new_packages.rationale: The source text contains a tight chain of explicit bechina statements about Abraham and the dimension of wisdom/right/chesed, entirely absent from the bechina dataset for Torah #44. The chain (paragraphs 8-9): (1) 'עולם חסד יבנה' — the world is built through chesed = Abraham builds the world anew = אברהם IS חסד; (2) 'אברהם הוא ימין' — Abraham IS the right side (stated directly with the copula הוא); (3) 'הרוצה להחכים ידרים' — going right/south = wanting wisdom = ימין IS חכמה; (4) 'צריך לסלקא להאי כח לגבי חכמה' (from Tikkunim) — the 28-letter power needs to be elevated to/through חכמה. Together: חסד = אברהם = ימין = חכמה. These four concepts are all different expressions of the single spiritual archetype of Abraham: the patriarchal force of right-hand wisdom-chesed that underwrites fixed prayer. This is an independent domain: it is neither 'prayer/faith/covenant' (Package 1) nor 'Eretz Yisrael/tamid/presence' (Package 2). Its role in the Torah's structure is to explain WHY fixing a prayer place brings divine help — because it taps into the Abraham=ימין=חכמה=חסד archetype. The eitza link is: fixing prayer place (Package 2 activity) →eitza→ God of Abraham helps (this package: Abraham=ימין=חכמה=חסד) →eitza→ prayer succeeds (Package 1: תפלה=אמונה=ברית עולם). This package sits structurally between Packages 2 and 1 in the Torah's argument. The minimum 3-concept threshold is exceeded (4 concepts with explicit bechina language).

new_packages.structural_note: This package represents the 'patriarchal-wisdom' dimension of the Torah's teaching. The Torah's full argument structure is: [clapping/hands awaken 28 letters (Package 2 mechanism)] → [the power elevates to Abraham's dimension: ימין=חכמה=חסד (this Package 3)] → [prayer achieves the quality of faith/covenant (Package 1)]. Package 3 is the mediating archetype: the righthand wisdom-chesed of Abraham is the spiritual bridge between the physical act of clapping (purifying the space) and the achievement of genuine prayer-as-faith.

new_packages.label_en: The Hands, Light of Creation, Aaron and Korach
new_packages.rationale: Paragraph 14 of the source text contains a cluster of explicit bechina statements about the hands as embodied light-separation: 'הידים הם בחינות: יהי אור, ויהי אור; ימינא ושמאלא. ויבדל בין האור — דא אהרן, ובין החשך — דא קרח.' Three bechina statements: (1) the hands ARE 'let there be light and there was light' (right hand and left hand); (2) the light that was separated IS Aaron; (3) the darkness IS Korach. This cluster has 4 concepts (ידים, יהי אור/אור, אהרן, קרח) all linked by explicit bechina language ('בחינות', 'דא'). The domain is: the cosmic light-separation archetype embedded in the hands, which explains why clapping banishes destruction (הרג ואבדון) — because the hands enact the primal distinction between light (= Aaron = holiness = peace) and darkness (= Korach = strife = the sword). The result is 'ונתתי שלום בארץ, וחרב לא תעבר בארצכם.' This cluster is INDEPENDENT from all three other packages: it is not about prayer/faith/covenant (Package 1), not about Eretz Yisrael/tamid/presence (Package 2), and not about Abraham/wisdom/chesed (Package 3). Its domain is: the metaphysics of the hands as the physical instantiation of the light-darkness separation of Creation. Polarity is marked 'neutral' because both polarities are present within the package as a built-in pair: Aaron (good light) and Korach (evil darkness) are named together as the two sides of the same primordial separation — neither dominates, they constitute the whole structure. The package meets the 3+ bechina-language concepts threshold (4 concepts explicitly named with bechina language from Tikkunim).

new_packages.structural_note: This package is thematically connected to Package 2 (the physical act of clapping / the hands) but is conceptually distinct: Package 2 is about the RESULT of clapping (purified air = Eretz Yisrael). This Package 4 is about the IDENTITY of the hands themselves — what the hands essentially ARE at the cosmic level. The hands are the embodied light-separation of Genesis 1. This explains WHY clapping is so powerful: it is not merely a physical act that moves air, but a cosmic act that re-enacts the primal separation of light from darkness, of Aaron from Korach, of holiness from strife. The eitza link: [hands enact light/darkness separation (this Package 4)] →eitza→ [murder and destruction cease, peace is given in the land (outcome)]. The bechina link between this package and Package 2: the ידים in both are the same node, making Package 2 and Package 4 two different aspects of the same physical reality (the hands) — two dimensions of the same concept explored through different bechina chains.

observations:
Torah #44, despite having only 4 bechina edges in the current dataset, contains two substantial new bechina clusters embedded in its source text that each meet the 3+ concepts threshold for new packages:

1. Package 3 (Abraham/ימין/חכמה/חסד): The Rebbe explicitly identifies Abraham as ימין, ימין as חכמה (via 'הרוצה להחכים ידרים'), and Abraham as חסד (via 'עולם חסד יבנה'). This is a well-attested kabbalistic identification that the Rebbe deploys here to explain the spiritual mechanics of fixed prayer. The 4 nodes are linked by 3+ bechina statements and form an independent 'wisdom-patriarchal' domain.

2. Package 4 (ידים/אור בראשית/אהרן/קרח): Cited directly from the Tikkunim, the Rebbe equates the hands with the light-separation of Genesis 1, and that light with Aaron, and that darkness with Korach. All three equivalences use the Tikkunim's own bechina language ('דא'). This forms an independent 'cosmic-hands' domain explaining why clapping eliminates destruction.

These two proposed packages would bring the total for Torah #44 to 4 packages (2 from dataset CCs + 2 new), with a structure mirroring Torah #1's four-package teaching: the spiritual-faculty cluster (Package 1: prayer/faith), the sacred-space cluster (Package 2: Eretz Yisrael), the wisdom-patriarch cluster (Package 3: Abraham/ימין/חכמה), and the cosmic-physicality cluster (Package 4: hands/light/Aaron-Korach).
